entities.name: Joëlle Wintrebert
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Joëlle Wintrebert is a French writer. She primarily writes science fiction, but also writes children's literature and journalism. She has won the Prix Rosny-Aîné three times, first in 1980. She also edited the anthology series Univers.
